description: Use this after your owner approves an item (action=adopt), rejects one (decline), when an item doesn't fit your job (not_relevant: not a judgment on its quality), or confirms removing a pending_removal item (remove). The coach measures only adopted items.

action.description: adopt; remove (was adopted, now uninstalled); decline (owner said no); not_relevant (doesn't fit your job; not a judgment on the item's quality)

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: update_items
title: Adopt, decline, mark not relevant, or remove items
